messages.subject: half cauchy for precision
parts:
All,

I followed the INLA example in to re-create the loggamma prior for precision using expression, which worked (see below).
Using this example and  the discussion group thread for the half Cauchy but obtain error message (below) with the half Cauchy code below.
Any advice would be helpful.  Thanks!

Dan


Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :

  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.

  If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.

In addition: Warning message:

running command '"C:/data/R/R-3.3.1/library/INLA/bin/windows/64bit/inla.exe"  -b -s -v  "C:/Users/rawdidr/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpqIHrt7/file16586aea7ef4/Model.ini"' had status 1

 


y = rnorm(1)

 

################################################################################

#loggamma prior for precision with expression

lg = "expression:

a = 1;

b = 0.1;

precision = exp(log_precision);

logdens = log(b^a) - lgamma(a) + (a-1)*log_precision - b*precision;

log_jacobian = log_precision;

return(logdens + log_jacobian);"

 

hyper.new = list(prec = list(prior = lg))

r.new = inla(y ~ 1, data = data.frame(y),

             control.family = list(hyper = hyper.new))

 

############################################################################

#half Cauchy for precision with expression

loghc = "expression: 

          prec = exp(log_precision);

          scale = 1;

          logdens = -log(pi * scale) -log(1 + (prec/scale)^2);

          logjacobian = log_precision;

         return (logdens + logjacobian);"

 

hyper.hc = list(prec = list(prior = loghc))

r2 = inla(y ~ 1, data = data.frame(y),

             control.family = list(hyper = hyper.hc))
